findings.summary: The '7d' preset still uses `daysAgo(7)`, unchanged from before the fix. With `to` = today and an inclusive SQL window, this spans 8 calendar days (today back through today-7), not 7 — the exact off-by-one the brief calls out by name ("'Last 7 days' should span exactly 7 days, not 8"). Only '30d' and '90d' were corrected (to daysAgo(29)/daysAgo(89)); '7d' needs daysAgo(6) to span exactly 7 days.
